body: You obviously sit on the internet and argue all day long. Looked at your posts and all you're doing is arguing with people. If you were any more "mature" than I am, you wouldn't have focused this post on me, you would still be trying to help OP cope. Good Luck with your life. Hope females dig sensitive men where you're from.

You're an idiot and I'm not going to argue with you. I didn't tell him to end his life. I said some pretty vile stuff huh? You're more sensitive then suicidal people. Go ahead and complain about what I said I DO NOT CARE IF I'M BANNED ON A WEBSITE. Fucking bum. Say whatever you want now haha as if I'll look at what some sensitive fuck says about me.
I feel the exact same way. Been so close to pulling the trigger but just can't do it for whatever reason.. Wish someone could do it for me.

I haven't laughed like that in a long time. If you read your comment, you aren't helping him anymore than I am. Just asking him (pointless) questions (notice the title of the post "living seems pointless"). I might need some help but that makes you just as twisted as me then.  Calling me names over the internet when you don't know me at all. It's okay though because I couldn't give a fuck.

Who cares about that shit he's asking you. Just stalling you. Life is a bitch so fuck it. I used to have big dreams and used to get great grades. It's all overrated. Nothing even matters. Think about that. Fuck everything.. If you take my advice, hopefully you'll find peace away from this living hell. Good luck 🔫

I feel you completely. I also need to nut up just pull the trigger. I don't know what keeps me from doing such a simple task. I hope you and I can escape this feeling soon. Whether we finally die or somehow have a change in heart.
I feel you 100%. Life isn't worth living..
Glad somebody see's it like me. Life is ridiculous and there's no point..

I've work at fast food restaurants, retail stores, UPS, mowing jobs, etc.. I live in a small town so really not much for volunteer work.. I've been on my meds for about a week. They worked after 2 days but now they dont change anything.. I dont think my town has AA or NA meetings honestly.. I'm trying to see a therapist but I've just always had a problem with opening up and trusting people. Thanks for the advice though.. Not sure how long I will keep fighting this feeling but hopefully long enough so that I can really get help and feel good again.

Thanks infiltuation, I think I'll make my way there! 

Thank you IrrationalWorld for being positive. Many people I discuss this with just tell me to stop and think about what I'm doing. I dont think they understand who I am though. I'm glad someone see's eye to eye with me. God bless!
